title: Removals and suspensions, 2025-26
source: NYC Department of Education, Local Law 93 of 2015 Annual Report on Student Discipline 2025-26 (sheet 'Annual Report --R-P-S Totals')

principal_suspensions.label: Principal's suspensions
principal_suspensions.definition: Number of principal's suspensions at the school during the 2025-26 school year (incidents, not students). DOE: 'A principal can suspend a student for one to five school days' (schools.nyc.gov/school-life/safe-schools/suspensions).

superintendent_suspensions.label: Superintendent's suspensions
superintendent_suspensions.definition: Number of superintendent's suspensions during 2025-26. DOE: 'imposed for more serious behavior and may result in a period of suspension for more than five school days.'

total_suspensions.label: Total suspensions
total_suspensions.definition: Principal's plus superintendent's suspensions. Computed by this script (not a column in the file), only when neither part is redacted; otherwise null.

suspensions_shown.label: Suspensions shown
suspensions_shown.definition: Sum of the principal's and superintendent's counts DOE shows, counting a redacted part as 0. When suspensions_hidden_parts is 0 this equals total_suspensions; otherwise it is a floor, since the true total is at least this.
suspensions_shown.source_field: PRINCIPAL + SUPERINTENDENT, redacted parts as 0 (sheet 'Annual Report --R-P-S Totals')

suspensions_hidden_parts.label: Redacted suspension counts
suspensions_hidden_parts.definition: How many of the two suspension counts (principal's, superintendent's) DOE redacted for the school: 0, 1 or 2.
suspensions_hidden_parts.source_field: count of 'R' in PRINCIPAL, SUPERINTENDENT (sheet 'Annual Report --R-P-S Totals')

removals.label: Teacher removals
removals.definition: Number of removals from class during 2025-26. The Discipline Code allows a teacher to remove a student whose behavior 'is substantially disruptive to the education process'; removed students stay in school and get classwork elsewhere in the building.

total_removals_suspensions.label: Removals plus suspensions
total_removals_suspensions.definition: DOE's own total of removals, principal's suspensions and superintendent's suspensions for 2025-26.

notes: Counts are incidents (removals or suspensions issued), not students. The file carries no enrollment, so no per-student rate is computed here.

Suppression: cells marked 'R' are redacted and stored as null. DOE's companion LL93 summary for 2025-26 (10052026-october-2025--ll93-annual-report-dl-final-redacted.pdf) says: 'Per the legislation and in accordance with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA), any value from zero (0) to five (5) has been redacted.' In this file the smallest number shown is 6.

Where one suspension count is shown and the other is redacted (512 schools), suspensions_shown is a floor: the school had at least that many. Where both are redacted (310 schools), DOE's rule puts each at 0 to 5, so 0 to 10 in all. This script never fills in a redacted cell, and does not work one out from DOE's TOTAL column, which DOE sometimes shows when parts are redacted.

Blank cells are stored as 0. The file doesn't define blanks, but for every blank cell the same workbook's DAYS sheet shows zero incidents of that type (1,261 blank cells checked, 0 exceptions), and a cell whose DAYS row is redacted is not contradicted. That is despite the PDF's '0 to 5' wording.

total_suspensions is principal's plus superintendent's suspensions, added by this script only when both parts are shown (numbers or blanks). The file's own TOTAL column also includes removals and is kept separately as total_removals_suspensions.
Direction is neutral. As THE CITY's school-vetting guide puts it, a high rate may mean strict discipline and a low rate doesn't guarantee a calm school.

Coverage: 1,271 DOE schools (districts 1-32, 75 and 79). Charter schools aren't in the report. DOE schools missing from the file get no record here; the file doesn't say whether a missing school had zero incidents.
The Grand Total row matches the summary PDF's 2025-26 totals (19,284 principal's and 4,549 superintendent's suspensions); the build stops if it doesn't.

Only the all-students sheet is used. The workbook's subgroup sheets (race, gender, grade, age, SWD, ELL, foster care, temporary housing, infraction codes, days, transfers) are not read, except that the DAYS sheet is used to confirm that blanks are zeros.
